name: Warlock
author: Johan Markström
description: Witchcraft is a crime in the Empire, but that doesn’t stop magicians from finding employ with wealthy patrons. In Mordheim they barter their perilous craft for wyrdstone and a chance to uncover magical relics lost in the ruins.

abilities.name: Wither
abilities.text: Magical ability. Select a visible enemy fighter within 12". That fighter must reduce its Move, Fight and Shoot characteristic by (X/2) until the end of the battle round.

abilities.name: Flight of Zimmerman
abilities.text: Magical ability. This fighter makes a free move action, and for that move action, they count as flying. However, while flying, they cannot move vertically upwards more than (X)".

abilities.name: Fires of U'Zhul
abilities.text: Magical ability. Select an enemy fighter within 12" of this fighter to be the target and roll three d6. For each roll of 3+, allocate (X/2) damage to the target. For each roll of 6, allocate (X/2) damage points to all visible fighters within 2" of the target.
